title: Inventory Analytics Query CPU Saturation
summary: Unindexed database query on inventory logs causing high CPU utilization on primary DB instance following deployment v2.5.0.
symptoms: Slow query log reporting 45+ second sequential scans on inventory_items table
Read latency spike across inventory dashboard
root_cause: Missing index on inventory_items(tenant_id, updated_at) after schema migration script in deployment v2.5.0.
